groups.procedure: With every source absent: deburr/clean per supplier, torque terminals on bench first. Fully cap exposed stud/screw tip, nut/washer/tongue and transitions to intact factory nylon/jacket. Two complete half-lapped passes and folded end cushion, finish with relaxed lap. Do not bridge adjacent terminals, obstruct toggle/key, claim strain relief, or cover hot dissipating components. Replace disturbed tape after service.
